title: SuperWorld
tagline: The only NEO bank world needs - Pay, Lend, Borrow and Invest
description: SuperWorld is the NEO bank which opens the gateway for crypto banking to the world. User can send money using username or the wallet address. User can lend and borrow money with the fix interest rate and manage their credit score. User can see the profile and summary across all the investments they have, and get the regular insights on their investments
how_its_made: It's a mini app inside world app. The app is made using NextJS, TailwindCSS, World Mini Kit. Smart contracts are coded in Solidity and deployed to World Sepolia and Polygon Amoy. The app uses login feature from World App and  uses Self Protocol for the KYC verification. It also uses wagmi for contract interactions.
